messages:
alex: Packaging/transport handoff for private-vpc installer v2.3.0-delta is ready. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-offline/installs/v2.3.0-delta. Need ops QA + deploy-bot pin for a small canary (5 hosts) in the 23:00-23:30 UTC change window. TL;DR: cosign signatures present, shrinkwrap delta applied, size down ~22%.

maria: I started checksum/verify run. running: `sha256sum installer-v2.3.0-delta.tar.gz`

maria: checksum OK: `sha256: 9f4d7e2a3b8c4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9`

lia: tagging/pinning plan: will pin images to `redwood/installer:v2.3.0-delta-20260321` and create sealed manifest in `manifests/private/v2.3.0-delta.json`. Also uploading cosign pubkey used for verification.

sam: rollback note: if canary error rate > 3% or any manifest signature mismatch, immediate rollback to `v2.2.9` (current stable). Rollback steps are in the runbook (ops-runbook -> section 4). I rechecked the runbook to confirm TTL on staging mirror fallback.

nina: Release notes snippet for packaging team: "Private/VPC installer 2.3.0-delta: fix KV cache init on nested mounts; cosign key rotation support; packaging size reduction; improved preflight checks for airgapped installs." I'll paste final notes to the release notes doc after we finish canary results.

alex: @deploy-bot can you pin `v2.3.0-delta` to the private-vpc release channel and start canary when ready? Also please set `max_canary=5` and `timeout=15m`.

deploy-bot: Received pin request: pinning `redwood/installer:v2.3.0-delta-20260321` -> channel `private-vpc/canary`. Preparing canary group (5 hosts). ETA ~2m.

maria: quick smoke on first host: `./installer --airgap --preflight` -> preflight OK, service start OK, health check 200/200. No cosign warnings.

lia: I pushed the sealed manifest to the S3 manifest bucket and updated the `pinned.json` in the private registry. Confirmed TTL and replication to the staging mirror (edge-1, edge-2).

sam: Ops checklist run (short): certs valid, KMS access tested, healthy nodes >=5, disk health ok. All green. If we see any curl 5xx to metadata endpoint, we abort.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: group=private-vpc-canary-20260321-01, hosts=5, step=serial-1-per-2min, timeout=15m. Monitoring metrics: latency, service-up, cosign-verify.

maria: Observing logs: host-3 reported transient `/var/lib/installer` permission warnings at 00:07:12 UTC, installer retried, recovered. No user-facing errors.

alex: keep an eye. If it retries more than 3 times on any host, abort.

nina: Noting customer-facing impact: none expected; will delay release notes publish until canary completes.

lia: small ask — can we set an automatic fallback manifest to `v2.2.9` in case of deploy failure? I can update fallback pointer now.

sam: yes please set fallback pointer. Also schedule a fast rollback window 23:30-23:50 in case we need it. Communicate to CS if we abort.

deploy-bot: Fallback pointer set to `redwood/installer:v2.2.9`. Canary progress: 4/5 hosts successful, host-5 in progress.

maria: host-5 finished, final health checks pass. No post-install 5xxs observed in the 10m window.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: success=5, failed=0. Promoting to `private-vpc/stable-candidate` requires a manual confirm.

alex: thumbs up from me. Proceed with promoting to stable-candidate and start the wider rollout tomorrow in the 03:00 UTC maintenance window.

nina: I'll finalize release notes and publish in the docs site under `/releases/private/v2.3.0-delta`. Adding a short note about the cosign rotation so customers can update their verification keys.

sam: closing ops checklist; flagged one non-blocking note about the retry logging on host-3 for follow-up.

lia: thanks all — pinned tags, manifests, and cosign keys are archived under `s3://redwood-release-archive/v2.3.0-delta/` with checksums.

alex: thanks team. Closing thread — will open a postmortem-only thread if we see any rollout regressions. :thumbsup:
